subject: Intro + traffic fingerprint for demo / pilot planning
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@curvemedia.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Demo request — self-serve signup (CurveMedia)

Hi Jasmine,

I signed up for Redwood from our product team this morning (Curvemedia). We’re evaluating inference platforms to replace our current multi-model pipeline — primary use cases are:
- embeddings + semantic search across user-generated articles and comments
- short-form generation to create feature summaries (150–300 tokens)

Quick traffic snapshot: roughly 2M tokens/day today across production and staging, typical request ~250 tokens, peak concurrency around 35 requests/sec during spikes. We expect to double traffic within 3 months if the PoC goes well.

We’re aiming to run a short POC (sample dataset + traffic replay) in the next 3–4 weeks, with a potential production decision by end of Q1.

I attached a small traffic sample CSV and a short security checklist. Can we schedule a 30–40 minute call this week to walk through capabilities, deployment options (hosted vs private), and typical pilot timelines?

Attendees likely: me (PM), our infra lead (Ravi Patel), and one engineer (Leah).

Thanks,
Samira Khan
Product Lead, CurveMedia
samira@curvemedia.com
+1 (415) 555-0189

Attachments: curvemedia_traffic_sample.csv, security-faq.pdf

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@curvemedia.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 16:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Demo request — self-serve signup (CurveMedia)

Hi Samira — welcome and thanks for the details, this is helpful. Looping in Monica (solutions eng) so she can join the technical portion. A few quick clarifying questions so we tailor the demo and pilot plan: 

1) Which capability is the priority for the pilot — embeddings search or generation/summaries? We can split the session but want to focus on the core win.
2) Average tokens you expect per inference for the two flows (you listed ~250; is that for both search & generation?)
3) Peak concurrent requests: you mentioned ~35 rps today — what headroom should we plan for during the PoC (x1.5, x2)?
4) Any data residency or VPC/VPN requirements for the PoC? You mentioned private earlier — is that a hard requirement for evaluation or negotiable later?
5) Security/compliance: do you need SOC2 artifacts or an NDA before we share detailed logs?

Proposed times (PST) for a 35–40 minute session this week:
- Tue Dec 15, 10:30–11:10
- Wed Dec 16, 09:00–09:40
- Wed Dec 16, 15:00–15:40

Or book directly: https://calendly.com/redwood/jasmine-30min

If you can reply with answers to Q1–Q5 and your preferred slot, I’ll send a calendar invite and a short agenda.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive – Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0123

---
Monica Patel (cc) — Monica will handle technical demo pieces (throughput tests, batching, KV/cache behavior, and private deployment options).

From: Samira Khan <samira@curvemedia.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 08:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Demo request — self-serve signup (CurveMedia)

Thanks Jasmine — answers below: 

1) Priority: embeddings + semantic search first (search relevance is the gating factor), then short-form generation for summaries during the same POC if time allows.
2) Tokens: search (embedding queries) translate to ~50 tokens per request on average; generation (summaries) ~200–300 tokens.
3) Peak planning: please design for x2 current spikes (so ~70 rps) — our traffic tends to burst during editorial drops.
4) Data residency: must stay in US regions for now. For the pilot we can use hosted but we’ll require VPC/private deployment for production. We want to validate both flows early.
5) Security: We need SOC2 Type II report and a data-processing addendum before production. For the PoC we can proceed after an NDA. I attached a brief security questionnaire and uploaded a larger traffic dump here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cCurvemediaTraffic

Preferred slot: Wed Dec 16, 09:00–09:40 PST. Attendees: Samira Khan (PM), Ravi Patel (Infra), Leah Moreno (Engineer).

Phone: +1 (415) 555-0189 if you want a quick sync.

Looking forward to the session.

Best,
Samira

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@curvemedia.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Dec 2026 09:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Demo request — self-serve signup (CurveMedia)

Great — Wed 09:00 PST is confirmed. I just sent the calendar invite to you, Ravi, and Leah.

Quick agenda (30–40m):
- 5m intros & goals for the PoC
- 10m walkthrough: embeddings + search architecture (indexing, vector store, latency expectations) — Monica
- 10m demo: traffic replay on a small sample, batching & KV cache behavior, expected token costs
- 10m deployment options & next steps (hosted PoC vs private pilot + timeline, compliance artifacts)

Pre-call asks (to make the session productive):
- Confirm which dataset within the Drive folder we should use for the replay (filename)
- If possible, a short list of 3 search queries that represent your most important relevance cases

I attached our Security FAQ and SOC2 info; I’ll follow up with the DPA and an NDA link before the call. Monica will be on the demo — she may ping you briefly beforehand to confirm the replay file.

See you Wednesday — invite in your inbox.

Cheers,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive – Redwood Inference
